questions.q: What does the Income Statement report?
options: Financial position at a single point in time
Performance (revenue, expenses, and the resulting net income) over a period of time
Only the company's cash balance
A list of unpaid customer invoices
questions.explain: The Income Statement (or Profit and Loss statement) reports performance over a period, such as a month or quarter, culminating in Net Income.

questions.q: What equation does the Balance Sheet's structure follow?
options: Revenue minus Expenses equals Net Income
Gross Margin equals Revenue minus COGS
Assets equals Liabilities plus Equity
Debits equal Credits only within Payables
questions.explain: The Balance Sheet follows the fundamental accounting equation: Assets = Liabilities + Equity, reported at a single point in time.

questions.q: How does Net Income from the Income Statement connect to the Balance Sheet?
options: It has no connection to the Balance Sheet at all
It becomes a new Asset line item directly
It replaces the Liabilities section entirely
It flows into Retained Earnings within the Balance Sheet's Equity section, period after period
questions.explain: Net Income accumulates into Retained Earnings on the Balance Sheet, linking the two statements across periods.

questions.q: In a Financial Reporting Studio Income Statement, what kind of row is "Gross Margin" typically built as?
options: A member pulled directly from the GL balances cube
A dashboard prompt
A duty role
A formula row: Revenue minus Cost of Goods Sold
questions.explain: Gross Margin, like Net Income, is typically a calculated formula row rather than a value pulled directly from the cube.

questions.q: What is one of the fast review checks an experienced consultant performs on a fresh Balance Sheet?
options: Confirming it has at least ten pages
Confirming it was built using OTBI rather than Financial Reporting Studio
Confirming the report has no eyebrow text
Confirming Assets equals Liabilities plus Equity exactly, to the cent
questions.explain: A Balance Sheet that doesn't balance exactly is one of the fastest signals that something in the close process needs investigation.
